query:
INSERT INTO notes (id, title, body, updated_at)
                         SELECT $1::uuid, $2, $3, $4
                         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                           SELECT 1 FROM tombstones
                           WHERE table_name = 'notes'
                             AND id = $1 AND deleted_at >= $4
                         )
                         ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
                           SET title = EXCLUDED.title,
                               body = EXCLUDED.body,
                               updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
